payload.intro:
The world's ten tallest completed buildings, by height to architectural top. The Burj Khalifa still leads by 149 m — a gap wider than the difference between numbers 2 and 6 combined. Merdeka 118 in Kuala Lumpur is the newest entrant and the only building to reach second place since 2015.

Heights are CTBUH figures to architectural top, as listed by Wikipedia. Photos are Wikimedia Commons images, each URL load-checked today.
